title: BLE-to-SenML relay driver
description:
Translate scanned BLE data to SenML packs and relay over LICHEN mesh.

**Requirements:**
- Consume (MAC, service UUID, characteristic UUID, value) from scanner
- Lookup IPSO object/resource via Appendix K mapping table
- Pack as SenML with bn=ble:<MAC>, appropriate n/u/v fields
- Rate limit outbound: max packets/minute per device, global cap
- Aggregate multiple readings into single SenML pack when possible
- Configurable destination (broadcast, specific IPv6, border router)

**CoAP config resource:**
```
GET/PUT /config/ble-relay
{
  "enabled": true,
  "max_pkt_per_device_min": 6,
  "max_pkt_global_min": 30,
  "aggregation_window_ms": 2000,
  "destination": "ff02::1"
}
```

**Depends on:**
- BLE scanner driver (worker6-3y7a)
- GATT-to-IPSO lookup table (worker6-dldn)
- SenML codec

Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md, spec/appendix-senml.md
